target.statement: GPT-4o achieves an overall score of 81.2 on the Direct Mimic task (testmini set) of ChartMimic.

compute.basis: The target requires calling the closed-source GPT-4o API on 1200 testmini examples, which is not feasible on a laptop without API access; even with API access, the cost and time would be substantial, and the evaluation code may be incomplete.

blockers: Requires closed-source GPT-4o API (gpt-4o-2024-05-13) for both generation and evaluation
Potential missing evaluation code or dependencies in the public repository
High API cost and rate limits for 1200 examples
title: ChartMimic: Evaluating LMM's Cross-Modal Reasoning Capability via Chart-to-Code Generation
